book.name: 2 CORINTIOS
book.title: ISCAB CARTA NAJ SAN PABLO YATO TET MACTA AYXACO YUL ISKꞌAB COMAM BEY CORINTO

content: Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ chon̈colwahan̈ comunlahan̈ yin̈ ismunil Comam Dios, yuxin chi-elto-jawan̈ teyin̈ ta mach cheyintan̈ecanilto iscꞌulchꞌanil iscꞌul Comam Dios.
Chal Comam Dios yul Yum hacaꞌ tiꞌ:

content.text: Yin̈ istiempohal quinhawawtehan tawin̈, wabetojan tzet hawala; yin̈ istzꞌayical hawoche hacolbanil quincolwahan tawin̈, ẍiayoj.

content: Yuxin tinan̈ istiempohalxa heyawten Comam teyin̈, yeb xin istzꞌayicalxa hechahni hecolbanil.
Han̈on̈tiꞌan̈ caw cꞌul chijute cobeybalan̈ yun̈e machi mac chijakꞌ lectahojan̈, yuto mach chisje cocꞌulan̈ tato ay mac chihalni iskꞌumal huneꞌ comuniltiꞌan̈.
Wal xin caw chicoyehan̈ yin̈ tzet chicowatxꞌehan̈ ta caw yeli ischejab Comam Dios jehan̈, yuxin chijakꞌ janmahan̈ jijlenan̈ isyaꞌtajil chihul jiban̈an̈, yeb man̈tzetal, yebpaxo yecꞌyaꞌ janmahan̈.
Ay bay caw con̈makꞌlaxan̈, ay bay xin con̈alaxicojan̈ preso, yeb xin ay bay ah wejna anma jin̈an̈, ay bay xin caw con̈ecꞌyaꞌan̈ comunlahan̈, aypaxo bay xin el cowayan̈an̈, ay bay jijlepaxojan̈ wahil.

Chicoyenipaxilojan̈ tato ischejab Comam Dios jehan̈ yu iscꞌulal chicowatxꞌehan̈, johtaxahan̈ baytet istꞌin̈anil, yuxin chijakꞌ nimancꞌulalan̈ yin̈ anma, cꞌulchꞌan chijutepaxo cocꞌulan̈ yuto ayco Comam Espíritu Santo yul janmahan̈, cat cotzalapaxojan̈ yin̈ jet anmahil.

Chicoyepaxilojan̈ tato ischejab Comam Dios jehan̈ yuto haꞌ cuybanile caw yel chijalan̈, yeb yu ayco yip Comam Dios jin̈an̈. Hacaꞌ hunu naj soldado chiscol isba yu ismunlabal cat yakꞌnipaxo naj howal yu ismunlabal tuꞌ; hacon̈tuꞌan̈ yuto haꞌ istoholal chijalicꞌojan̈.

Ay bay niman jelapnojan̈ yul sat anma, aypaxo bay xin chiilaxilo copixanan̈. Ay bay cꞌul istzotel anma jin̈an̈, ay bay xin txꞌoj istzotel anma jin̈an̈. Ay bay chon̈hallaxan̈ lekꞌtiꞌal, waxan̈ca xin haꞌ isyelal chijalan̈.
Ay bay challaxi tato mach con̈yohtajojan̈ anma, waxan̈ca xin caw ohtabilon̈an̈ yu. Camomon̈xahan̈ yalni anma, yajaꞌ itzitzon̈an̈, chiꞌalaxpaxayo isyaꞌtajil jiban̈an̈, yajaꞌ mach chon̈caman̈.

Hacaꞌtan̈e biscꞌulal jehan̈, yajaꞌ wal xin tzalahilaln̈eticꞌa jehan̈ yin̈ sunilbal tiempo. Waxan̈ca caw mebaꞌon̈an̈, yajaꞌ tzetcꞌa mac kꞌalom yul sat Comam Dios juhan̈. Waxan̈ca machi nichꞌano tzet ayon̈an̈, yajaꞌ yul sat Comam Dios tzꞌajan yeco sunil yul cokꞌaban̈.
Hex wuẍtaj, hex wanab, hex ayex bey Corinto, caw chijaltojan̈ isyelal teyet yeb sunil tzet ay yin̈ janmahan̈.
Caw machi hunu tzet ye tuꞌ chijebahan̈ teyet, wal hex tiꞌ xin ay huntekꞌan tzet ye tuꞌ ewan ye jetan̈ heyu.
Hacaꞌ yay sat hunu naj mame tet iscꞌahol, hac tuꞌ yay insatan teyet, chinkꞌannihan tato haꞌ caw isyelal haꞌ cheyal wetan, hacaꞌ chu walnitojan tzet ay yul wanmahan teyet.
Han̈on̈ tiꞌ yatuton̈xa Comam Dios itzitz

Mach chu heyetbin̈en heba yeb anma maẍto chichahni Comam yul yanma, yuto ¿tom chu yetbin̈en isba iscꞌulal yeb istxꞌojal? Yeb xin ¿tom chu yetbin̈en isba sajilkꞌinal yeb kꞌejholo? ¡Wal xin mach chuhi!
Yeb ¿tom chu islahban isnabal Comam Jesucristo yeb naj matzwalil? Yeb xin han̈on̈ xacochah Comam Jesucristo yul janma, ¿tom chu colahban conabal yeb mac maẍto chichahni Comam yul yanma? ¡Mach chuhi!
¿Tom ay yocbalto tioẍ yul yatut Comam Dios? ¡Machoj! Yuto han̈on̈ tiꞌ yatut Comam Dios itzitz jehi, hacaꞌ yalni yul Yum Comam Dios bay chala:

content.text: Hanintiꞌan chinehayojan xol ebnaj cat xin wecꞌan yeb ebnaj, haninan xin chinocan isdiosaloj, cat yoc ebnaj incon̈obojan, ẍi Comam.
Yu huneꞌ tuꞌ, yuxin yalpaxo Comam: Elan̈we xol ebnaj, pohilo heba yin̈ ebnaj. Mach chetzab huntekꞌan tzet ye tuꞌ machiswalil, hac tuꞌ xin chexinchahan incꞌatan̈an.
Chinocan hemamoj, cat heyoc incꞌaholojan yeb xin incutzꞌinojan, ẍi Comam Dios Jahawil, Comam chisje iswatxꞌen sunil tzet ye tuꞌ, ẍiayoj.
